stem.text: Part of the structure of a fungicide, strobilurin, is shown. $\text{R}$ and $\text{R}^{\prime}$ are inert groups.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of strobilurin with R and R' groups: a conjugated diene chain, a methyl branch, and a methyl ester group (CO2CH3) on a C=C.
stem.label: strobilurin

stem.text: In this reaction, strobilurin is warmed with aqueous sulfuric acid producing compound X. Compound X is then treated with hydrogen in the presence of a nickel catalyst producing compound Y.
What could be the structure of compound Y?

A.alt: Skeletal structure: chain from R with a methyl branch, a carbon bearing a COOH (carboxylic acid) group, and a CH2-R' end group.

B.alt: Skeletal structure: chain from R with a methyl branch, a carbon bearing both OH and OCH3 groups, and a CH2-R' end group.

C.alt: Skeletal structure: chain from R with a methyl branch, a CH2OH group, and a CH2-R' end group.

D.alt: Skeletal structure: chain from R with OH groups on two carbons, a COOH (carboxylic acid) group, a methyl branch, and a CH(OH)-R' end group.
